# Airfried 300

> Three hundred air-fryer recipes (currently 126). Editorial-cookbook site for home cooks: each recipe tested in a basket, written from a real food photograph, with ingredients, numbered method steps, and notes on substitutions and make-ahead.

Airfried is a static recipe site at airfried300.com. Every recipe is image-anchored — the photograph determines the ingredients and the dish. Methods skew air-fryer-heavy but the site also covers stovetop, no-cook, no-bake, skillet, and blender recipes for weekday cooking. Recipes are written in a warm, slightly conversational editorial voice; each includes active time, total time, yield, difficulty, and category metadata in YAML frontmatter (source MDX, rendered to static HTML).

## Site structure
- [Home](https://airfried300.com/): Featured recipes and editorial bands.
- [All recipes](https://airfried300.com/recipes): Browseable index of all 126 recipes.
- [Sitemap](https://airfried300.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of all URLs.

## Air-fryer recipes
- [5-Minute Air-Fryer S'mores](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-smores): Graham crackers, marshmallows, chocolate, the air fryer in lieu of a campfire. Two minutes at 380°F and the marshmallow puffs and goes molten on top, the chocolate softens just enough to smear when you close the sandwich. No bonfire, no smoke alarm.
- [Air-Fryer Apple Fritters](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-apple-fritters): Diced apple folded into a cinnamon-spiced batter, dropped by the spoonful onto parchment, air-fried until the outsides go golden, then drizzled with vanilla glaze. The Pennsylvania-Dutch country diner pastry, made at home in twenty-five minutes.
- [Air-Fryer Apple Pie Crescent Rolls](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-apple-pie-crescent-rolls): Pop a can of crescent dough, sauté an apple with butter and cinnamon, roll them up, dust with cinnamon sugar, and you have something between a diner pastry and grandma's pie — in twelve minutes, with no rolling pin.
- [Air-Fryer Bacon](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-bacon): No splattered hob, no grease puddles, no slick stove top to wipe down at 8 a.m. on a Saturday. Bacon laid flat in the basket, eight minutes at 400°F, comes out flat and shatteringly crisp. The way to cook bacon for everything else you're making.
- [Air-Fryer Bacon-Wrapped Asparagus](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-bacon-wrapped-asparagus): Asparagus spears spiraled in a single strip of bacon, air-fried until the bacon crackles and the asparagus stays just-tender. Five ingredients, twelve minutes, the side dish that vanishes off the platter faster than anything else on the table.
- [Air-Fryer Bacon-Wrapped Filets with Mushroom Sauce](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-bacon-wrapped-filets): Two filet mignons wrapped in a band of bacon, air-fried at 400°F to medium-rare, plated with a quick mushroom-and-red-wine pan sauce. Steakhouse dinner at home in thirty-five minutes — same temperature precision the chef gets, none of the markup.
- [Air-Fryer Baked Eggs in Tomato Sauce](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-baked-eggs): Eggs baked in a quick spiced tomato sauce — paprika, garlic, red pepper, onion — with toasted sourdough for dipping. The shakshuka template, scaled down for two ramekins, executed in the air fryer in twenty minutes flat.
- [Air-Fryer Baked Oats, Three Ways](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-baked-oats): Single-serving baked oats in a ramekin — soft, cake-like, sweetened only by banana and maple. Twelve minutes in the air fryer. Three topping directions so you don't get bored on day four.
- [Air-Fryer Baked Potatoes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-baked-potatoes): The proper baked potato — skin crackling and salt-crusted, interior fluffy enough to fork — without an hour of waiting for the oven. Forty minutes in the air fryer, no foil, no microwave shortcut. The side dish that quietly becomes the main course.
- [Air-Fryer Banana Bread](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-banana-bread): A proper banana loaf — not the cookies — baked in a small loaf tin in the air fryer. Three black bananas, brown sugar, a handful of pecans on top. Forty minutes start to finish, no oven, perfect for the days the kitchen is too hot to use the real one.
- [Air-Fryer Banana Bread Cookies](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-banana-bread-cookies): The cookie that resolves the breakfast/dessert argument by refusing to choose. Two ripe bananas, a cup of oats, a handful of chocolate chips, ten minutes in the air fryer. Soft middle, slight crisp edges, gone by lunch.
- [Air-Fryer Bean Tostadas](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-bean-tostadas): Corn tortillas air-fried until they puff and crisp like proper tostada shells, then loaded with refried black beans, shredded cheese, lettuce, and chopped tomato. The five-minute weeknight dinner that's also somehow a complete meal — beans, grains, vegetables, dairy, all on one plate.
- [Air-Fryer Beef & Broccoli Noodles](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-beef-broccoli-noodles): Steak strips, broccoli, carrot ribbons, baby corn — all blistered in the air-fryer basket, then tossed with stir-fry noodles and a quick soy-ginger sauce. The Chinese-takeaway dish made in twenty-five minutes without a wok, without an inch of oil.
- [Air-Fryer Bell Pepper Shrimp](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-bell-pepper-shrimp): Shrimp, red pepper, onion, a spice rub heavy on smoked paprika and chili, finished with lime and cilantro over brown rice. From frozen shrimp to bowl in twelve minutes, no skillet to wash.
- [Air-Fryer Blackberry & Apple Crumble](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-blackberry-apple-crumble): Blackberries and bramley apples bubbling under a buttery oat crumble — the British autumn dessert, ready in thirty minutes instead of fifty. The juices stain the crumble dark red where they break through; served with vanilla ice cream pooling.
- [Air-Fryer Breaded Chicken Tenders](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-breaded-chicken-tenders): Panko, parmesan, paprika, a buttermilk brine, and twelve minutes at 400°F. Shattering crust, juicy middle, no deep-fry oil, no soggy bottom. The chicken tender of the airline-meal era, redeemed.
- [Air-Fryer Breakfast Hash with Fried Egg](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-breakfast-hash): Baby potatoes diced small, tossed with red pepper and onion, air-fried until the edges crisp and the centres stay fluffy. Topped with a single white-as-paper fried egg — the yolk runs through the hash on contact. Diner breakfast, made in twenty minutes, no greasy stove.
- [Air-Fryer British Sausages](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-sausages): Plain, fat, pale-skinned British sausages — the kind you'd get in a bap — air-fried at 380°F until the skin tightens, browns, and just starts to split. Twelve minutes from cold to plate, no spluttering pan, no rolling them around the hob with tongs.
- [Air-Fryer Brussels Sprouts, Chilli-Honey Glaze](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-brussels-sprouts): The brussels sprout, redeemed. Halved sprouts air-fried until the outer leaves char and the centres go nutty, then tossed warm with a glaze of soy, honey, and chili flakes. The side dish that converts even the brussels-sprout sceptics in the room.
- [Air-Fryer Butternut Squash Tacos](https://airfried300.com/recipes/butternut-squash-tacos): Butternut squash cubed and tossed in chipotle, smoked paprika, and cumin, air-fried until the edges caramelize. Stacked into warm corn tortillas with avocado, red onion, queso fresco, and a squeeze of lime. The fall vegetable taco that's worth eating in any season.
- [Air-Fryer Cheese & Ham Toastie](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-cheese-ham-toastie): Sourdough buttered on the outside, packed with a mustard-spiked cheddar-and-parmesan mix, two slices of ham, fresh chives. Air-fried at 380°F for six minutes — comes out with the bread the colour of toffee, the cheese oozing at the edges. The toastie maker, retired.
- [Air-Fryer Cheese & Marmite Crumpet Loaf](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-cheese-marmite-crumpet-loaf): A whole pack of crumpets stacked in a loaf tin, smeared with butter and Marmite, layered with sharp cheddar, air-fried until the cheese bubbles down between the crumpet ridges and the edges go biscuit-gold. The British comfort food made architectural.
- [Air-Fryer Chicken Breast](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-chicken-breast): Eight minutes of seasoning and ten of unattended cooking. The chicken breast comes out with grill-style char marks, fully cooked but never dry, sliced over a salad of mixed greens, cucumber, and avocado. The weeknight default dinner.
- [Air-Fryer Chicken Nuggets](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-chicken-nuggets): Homemade chicken nuggets, twelve minutes in the air fryer. Real chicken breast cut into bite pieces, double-dredged in seasoned panko, sprayed with oil, cooked until the breadcrumb crust shatters. The kid-food most adults would order if it were on the menu.
- [Air-Fryer Chicken Taquitos](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-taquitos): Flour tortillas rolled tight around shredded chicken and cheese, then air- fried until the outside blisters and shatters. Eight minutes to a dinner that uses last night's rotisserie chicken and feels like takeout from the place that's always closed when you want it.
- [Air-Fryer Chicken Thighs](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-chicken-thighs): Bone-in, skin-on thighs — the cut that's almost impossible to overcook — rubbed with herbs and paprika, air-fried at 400°F until the skin crackles and the meat slides off the bone. Roasted potatoes and carrots cook in the same basket. One pan, no compromises.
- [Air-Fryer Chili-Lime Crispy Chickpeas](https://airfried300.com/recipes/chili-lime-roasted-chickpeas): A can of chickpeas, drained and dried, tossed with olive oil and a punchy chili-lime spice blend, air-fried at 400°F until they crackle. The pantry snack that's both healthier than chips and more satisfying. Sixteen minutes from can to bowl.
- [Air-Fryer Chips (Proper British)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-chips): Maris Piper potatoes cut chunky — proper British chip-shop thickness, not those skinny American fries — soaked, dried, tossed in oil, air- fried in two stages at different temperatures. Comes out with the shattering exterior and fluffy interior of the takeaway version, served with mayo and ketchup.
- [Air-Fryer Chocolate-Stuffed Cookie Pie](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-cookie-pie): Chocolate chip cookie dough pressed into a small round pan, packed in the middle with a layer of melted Nutella, topped with more dough, air-fried until the outside crusts and the inside stays molten. The "I want a warm cookie" recipe with the volume turned all the way up.
- [Air-Fryer Cinnamon Apple Chips](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-apple-chips): Apples sliced thin, dusted with cinnamon (no sugar — the apple is sweet enough), air-fried at low heat until they go from soft to crisp. The snack you make when you want something sweet but don't want it to be a project. Pantry-staple ingredients, twenty unattended minutes.
- [Air-Fryer Cinnamon Sugar Donuts](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-cinnamon-sugar-donuts): Refrigerated biscuit dough, cut into rings, air-fried until they puff golden, then tumbled hot in cinnamon sugar. The donut hack that produces something almost indistinguishable from a fresh bakery donut — and takes ten minutes from can to plate.
- [Air-Fryer Cinnamon-Glazed Doughnuts](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-glazed-doughnuts): Refrigerated biscuit dough, cut into rings, air-fried until the outsides go bronze and the insides puff into something cake-doughnut-adjacent. Then tumbled while hot in cinnamon sugar for a snowy, cracked-crust coating. Eight minutes from can to plate.
- [Air-Fryer Club Sandwich](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-club-sandwich): Three-tiered club: toasted white bread, mayo, sliced chicken, crispy bacon, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, repeated. The bacon and bread both go through the air fryer; the chicken can be leftover or freshly grilled. The diner classic, stacked tall, cut on the diagonal, eaten with both hands.
- [Air-Fryer Coconut Shrimp with Apricot Sauce](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-coconut-shrimp): Shrimp dredged in seasoned flour, dipped in egg, then crusted heavy in sweetened coconut and panko, air-fried at 400°F until the coconut goes bronze. Served with a glossy apricot-and-chili dipping sauce. The tropical appetizer that's somehow a main course because nobody can stop eating it.
- [Air-Fryer Crisps with Caramelised Onion & Soured Cream Dip](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-crisps-onion-dip): Thinly sliced potatoes air-fried into proper crisps (American: chips), paired with a thick soured-cream dip stirred with shop-bought caramelised onion chutney, topped with crispy fried onions and chives. The pub snack, made at home for half the price and twice the freshness.
- [Air-Fryer Crispy Chicken Wings](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-crispy-chicken-wings): Wings, baking powder, a pat dry, twenty-five minutes at 400°F. The skin comes out shattering — the kind of crunch that's been the reason people order wings for sixty years — without the deep-fryer oil. Serve with hot sauce and honey on the side.
- [Air-Fryer Crispy Chilli Beef](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-crispy-chilli-beef): The Chinese-takeaway classic, made in your air fryer without the inch of oil. Sirloin strips coated in cornflour go crisp at 200°C, then tossed in a sticky soy-chilli sauce with red pepper, garlic, and a heavy hand of fresh chilli. Eight minutes in the basket.
- [Air-Fryer Crispy Root-Vegetable Crisps](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-root-veg-crisps): Parsnip, beetroot, sweet potato, and carrot — all sliced paper-thin on a mandoline, tossed in a teaspoon of oil, air-fried low and slow until they go cracker-crisp. The chip-aisle snack made from things that were rolling around at the bottom of the vegetable drawer.
- [Air-Fryer Crispy Tofu with Coconut Grains](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-crispy-tofu-coconut-grains): Extra-firm tofu cubed, marinated in soy and sambal, dredged in cornflour, air-fried at 200°C until every face goes lacquer-crisp. Served on bulgur or quinoa cooked with coconut milk, finished with edamame, coriander, and lime. Twenty minutes hands-on for a dinner that pretends to be more effort than it is.
- [Air-Fryer Croutons](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-croutons): Stale bread, olive oil, garlic powder, six minutes at 380°F. They come out rubble-edged and crackling — better than every croquetone you've bought, cheaper than even the bad ones, and ready before you've finished the salad.
- [Air-Fryer Eggplant Parmesan Strips](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-eggplant-parm-strips): Eggplant cut into fingers, breaded with seasoned panko and parmesan, air-fried until the outside shatters and the inside goes meltingly soft. Served with marinara for dipping — eggplant parm, in appetiser form. The vegetarian dish that converts the carnivores at the table.
- [Air-Fryer Fish and Fries](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-fish-and-fries): Cod fillets dredged in cornflake-and-flour crust, fries cut chunky and double-fried, both done in the same basket on different schedules. Lemon, malt vinegar, a glass of beer. The British takeaway dinner, made in your kitchen without the deep fryer.
- [Air-Fryer French Toast Bites](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-french-toast-bites): French toast, cubed and air-fried — custardy inside, crackling outside, dusted in powdered sugar, served with a small bowl of maple syrup for spearing them through. Better than the pan version because every face gets crisp.
- [Air-Fryer French Toast Sticks (Cornflake-Crusted)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-french-toast-sticks): Thick-sliced bread cut into batons, soaked in custard, rolled in crushed cornflakes, air-fried until the cornflakes go bronze and the bread inside stays custardy. Dipped in maple syrup with fresh strawberries on the side. Saturday morning, weaponised.
- [Air-Fryer Fried Ice Cream Balls](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-fried-ice-cream-balls): Scoops of vanilla ice cream frozen rock-solid, rolled in crushed cornflakes and cinnamon, air-fried for ninety seconds — long enough to crisp the coating, fast enough to keep the centre frozen. Served with chocolate sauce pouring over. The dessert trick that turns dinner into theatre.
- [Air-Fryer Fried Pickles with Ranch](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-pickles): Dill pickle slices, patted dry, dredged in seasoned panko, air-fried until the breading crackles. Served with ranch for dipping. The Southern bar-snack standard, made at home in less time than it takes to debate ordering them.
- [Air-Fryer Frittata with Parma Ham Crisps](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-frittata-parma-ham): Eight eggs whisked with cream and parmesan, baked in a tin with cherry tomatoes, spring onions, and a flutter of fresh chives. Crisp-edged Parma ham served on the side, shattering when you bite it. The brunch dish made without flipping a pan.
- [Air-Fryer Fudgy Brownies](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-fudgy-brownies): Brownies with the crackly meringue top and the dense, fudgy middle — the structurally correct version, debated about endlessly on cooking forums — made in a small square pan in the air fryer. Twenty minutes start to finish, eight servings, the way to handle a Tuesday afternoon chocolate craving.
- [Air-Fryer Garlic-Butter Steak](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-garlic-butter-steak): A 1-inch ribeye or strip, salted hard, air-fried at 400°F to medium-rare, then topped with a slab of compound butter mashed with garlic, parsley, and lemon zest. The butter melts on contact and pools around the meat. Twenty minutes total.
- [Air-Fryer Garlic-Rosemary Brussels Sprouts with Parmesan](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-rosemary-brussels-sprouts): The savoury cousin to the chilli-honey version earlier in this collection — halved sprouts tossed in olive oil with rosemary and garlic, air-fried until the outer leaves char, then finished hot with a heavy snow of parmesan and golden breadcrumbs. The Thanksgiving side that gets requested every December afterward.
- [Air-Fryer Goose-Fat Roast Potatoes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-goose-fat-roasties): Maris Pipers parboiled until shaggy at the edges, dressed in a heavy spoonful of goose fat, air-fried at 200°C until the outsides shatter and the insides go cloud-soft. The Christmas-dinner potato, made in thirty-five minutes flat instead of an hour and a half in the oven.
- [Air-Fryer Grilled Cheese Sandwiches (With Bacon and Tomato)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-grilled-cheese): Buttered sourdough, two kinds of melting cheese, a thick tomato slice, three strips of crispy bacon, all closed up and air-fried until the bread goes toffee-coloured and the cheese spills out the sides. The platonic grilled cheese, made hands-off in six minutes.
- [Air-Fryer Halloumi](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-halloumi): Halloumi sliced ½-inch thick, brushed with olive oil, air-fried at 400°F for six minutes. Comes out with deep grill-mark colour, crisp on the outside, squeaky-soft in the middle. The cheese that's basically begging to be turned into dinner.
- [Air-Fryer Hard-Boiled Eggs](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-hard-boiled-eggs): No boiling water, no timer-watching, no peeling that takes off half the white. Eggs straight into the basket, fifteen minutes at 270°F, ice bath, peel. The whites stay tender and the yolks set fully but not chalky. The most reliable hard-boil method on the home cook's bench.
- [Air-Fryer Harissa Sausage & Veg Traybake](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-harissa-traybake): Italian sausages glazed in rose harissa, butternut squash and red pepper roasted underneath, kale tossed in at the last minute for crisp green flecks. North-African heat applied to the British traybake template. One basket, twenty minutes, dinner.
- [Air-Fryer Herb-Lemon Cauliflower with Shrimp Skewers](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-herb-lemon-cauliflower): Cauliflower florets and shrimp on skewers, both air-fried together with garlic, parsley, lemon zest, and red pepper flakes. The protein-plus-vegetable dinner that's a complete meal in twenty minutes — Mediterranean-bright, gluten-free, almost embarrassingly easy.
- [Air-Fryer Italian-Herb Chicken Thighs](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-italian-herb-chicken): Bone-in chicken thighs rubbed with Italian herbs, garlic, and olive oil, then air-fried until the outside crusts dark and the inside stays meltingly tender. Served over a quick caesar salad — the kind of low-effort dinner that pretends to be more sophisticated than it is.
- [Air-Fryer Lemon-Parmesan Asparagus](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-lemon-parmesan-asparagus): Asparagus tossed in olive oil with lemon zest, garlic, salt, and a generous shower of grated parmesan, air-fried six minutes at 400°F. The tips go slightly charred, the parmesan melts into the surface, the lemon brightens the whole thing. The fastest side dish on the collection.
- [Air-Fryer Lemon-Pepper Salmon](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-lemon-pepper-salmon): Two fillets, a heavy hand with lemon-pepper seasoning, eight minutes at 400°F. The salmon comes out medium with a translucent center and a pebbled black-and-yellow crust. Serve with the lemon wedges already on the board.
- [Air-Fryer Loaded Baked Potato Chicken Strips](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-loaded-baked-potato-chicken-strips): Chicken strips coated in seasoned potato flakes mixed with crisp bacon bits, parmesan, and chives — every flavour of a loaded baked potato applied to the chicken-strip template. Twelve minutes in the air fryer, served with sour cream for dipping.
- [Air-Fryer Maple-Cinnamon Chickpeas](https://airfried300.com/recipes/maple-cinnamon-chickpeas): A can of chickpeas drained, dried, tossed with olive oil, then glazed with maple syrup and cinnamon halfway through cooking. Comes out crunchy at the edges, slightly chewy in the middle, salty-sweet — the protein-rich snack you reach for instead of crisps.
- [Air-Fryer Meatballs](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-meatballs): Twenty-four meatballs of beef and pork, parmesan, breadcrumbs, an egg to bind, rolled small enough to cook through in twelve minutes. The air fryer is the long-lost flatmate of the meatball — high heat, even browning, no oil-splattered hob.
- [Air-Fryer Meatloaf (Single-Serving)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-meatloaf): Two free-form mini meatloaves — beef, panko, milk-soaked breadcrumbs, ketchup-and-brown-sugar glaze — air-fried at 360°F. Smaller than the loaf-pan version, faster, the glaze caramelises properly. The diner classic, sized for actual humans rather than cafeterias.
- [Air-Fryer Mozzarella Sticks](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-mozzarella-sticks): String cheese sticks, twice-dredged in seasoned breadcrumbs, frozen solid, air-fried at 400°F for the shortest possible time so the cheese melts but doesn't leak. Served with marinara. The TGI-Friday's appetiser, made better, at home, in seven minutes flat.
- [Air-Fryer Old Bay Crispy Kale Chips](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-old-bay-kale-chips): Curly kale leaves torn off their stems, tossed in olive oil and Old Bay seasoning, air-fried at 300°F until they go thin-paper crisp without burning. The savoury chip-alternative that's somehow better than the bagged kind. Five minutes of work, seven minutes of cooking.
- [Air-Fryer Omelette with Spinach, Feta & Prosciutto](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-omelette): An omelette without a pan: eggs whisked with milk, poured into a small oiled dish, scattered with spinach, feta crumbles, and torn prosciutto, air-fried at 350°F for eight minutes. Comes out tall, set, slightly puffed — closer to a frittata than a French omelette, in the best way.
- [Air-Fryer Parmesan Zucchini Fries](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-zucchini-fries): Zucchini sticks dredged in parmesan-and-panko, air-fried until every face goes deep golden. Served with a small bowl of marinara for dipping. The fries that are technically a vegetable, served as if they're not, eaten until they're gone.
- [Air-Fryer Peanut Butter Cookies](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-peanut-butter-cookies): The famous three-ingredient peanut butter cookie — peanut butter, sugar, egg, fork-marks on top — turned out in eight minutes per batch in the air fryer. Naturally gluten-free, ready before the oven would have preheated, dense and chewy in the middle. Glass of milk required.
- [Air-Fryer Pizza Bagel Bites](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-pizza-bagel-bites): Mini bagels split, smeared with marinara, blanketed in mozzarella, six minutes at 380°F. The bagel toasts dark on the underside, the cheese bubbles and edges blister, the kitchen smells like Friday afternoon.
- [Air-Fryer Pork Chops](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-pork-chops): Thin-cut boneless pork chops, rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, air-fried at 400°F for eight minutes. They come out with a peppery crust, a slightly caramelised exterior, and the centres still juicy — the dinner that takes longer to season than it does to cook.
- [Air-Fryer Pork Joint with Crackling](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-pork-joint): A 2-lb pork loin joint, skin scored and salted, air-fried at high heat for the first ten minutes to blister the crackling, then dropped to 320°F for an hour to cook the meat through gently. The Sunday pork roast, smaller appliance, better crackling than the oven gives you.
- [Air-Fryer Raspberry-Glazed Ring Doughnuts](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-raspberry-glazed-doughnuts): Soft yeasted ring doughnuts air-fried until pillowy, dipped in a shocking-pink raspberry glaze made from real fresh raspberries and icing sugar, scattered with rainbow sprinkles. The Saturday-morning project doughnut — bakery-quality, kid-friendly, the colour of a 1950s diner.
- [Air-Fryer Roasted Garlic](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-roasted-garlic): Whole peeled cloves, a tablespoon of oil, twenty minutes at 380°F. They come out caramelised at the tips, sweet enough to spread on toast, ready to be smashed into a vinaigrette, a pasta, or your next bowl of mashed potatoes. The condiment you didn't know was a condiment.
- [Air-Fryer Roasted Vegetables](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-roasted-vegetables): New potatoes, butternut squash, red pepper, red onion — tossed with olive oil, thyme, salt, air-fried at 400°F for twenty-two minutes with one shake. Comes out caramelised at every edge, the squash gone soft, the potatoes properly crisp. The platter of vegetables that becomes the side, the salad, the next day's lunch.
- [Air-Fryer Rosemary-Garlic Red Potatoes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-red-potatoes): Baby red potatoes halved or quartered, tossed in oil with rosemary and garlic, air-fried at 400°F. Skins crisp, insides stay creamy the way only red potatoes do. The everyday side dish that goes with every protein on the kitchen counter.
- [Air-Fryer Rotisserie-Style Chicken Pieces](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-rotisserie-chicken-pieces): Bone-in, skin-on chicken pieces — thighs and drumsticks mixed — rubbed with the classic rotisserie spice mix and air-fried at 380°F. Same golden, juicy, slightly smoky result as the supermarket rotisserie chicken, made for half the cost in your own basket.
- [Air-Fryer Salmon Fish Cakes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-salmon-fish-cakes): Cooked salmon flaked into mashed potato with capers, dill, lemon zest, and a beaten egg to bind. Patted into rounds, breaded with panko, air-fried at 200°C until the outsides go biscuit-gold. Served with peppery rocket and a wedge of lemon.
- [Air-Fryer Salmon Patties](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-salmon-patties): Canned salmon (yes, canned), bound with egg and panko, mixed with scallion and dill, pan-shaped into patties and air-fried until the outsides go bronze and the insides stay tender. The pantry-staple fish dinner that costs $5 and looks like restaurant plating.
- [Air-Fryer Salt & Pepper Chicken](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-salt-pepper-chicken): Chinese-takeaway salt-and-pepper chicken: thigh chunks coated in five-spice cornflour, air-fried crisp, then tossed hot with red chilli, spring onions, bok choy, and a heavy pinch of Sichuan pepper-salt. The dish that's better than the takeaway because it arrives at the table hotter.
- [Air-Fryer Sausage, Peppers & Onions Subs](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-sausages-peppers-onions): Italian sausage, sliced bell peppers, onion, all in the basket together for twelve minutes. Pile onto a soft sub roll under a slice of provolone, the rolls toasted in the last two minutes. The Friday-night street food of New Jersey, made at home in less time than it takes to drive there.
- [Air-Fryer Shrimp Po'Boys with Celeriac Remoulade](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-shrimp-po-boys): Cajun-spiced shrimp, coated in crisp panko and air-fried until they shatter under your bite, stacked in a soft sub with shredded lettuce, gherkins, and a creamy celeriac remoulade that's basically tartare sauce's smarter cousin. The New Orleans corner-shop sandwich, redeemed.
- [Air-Fryer Spiced Prawn Tacos](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-prawn-tacos): Prawns tossed in a Mexican-leaning spice rub, air-fried for six minutes, piled into warm soft tortillas with avocado, beetroot, fresh coriander, and a drizzle of garlicky lime yogurt sauce. Twenty minutes from cold to plate. Beach-shack energy.
- [Air-Fryer Steak Fajitas](https://airfried300.com/recipes/steak-fajitas): Flank or skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic, and chili, air- fried to medium-rare, sliced thin against the grain, served with warm tortillas, avocado, and pico de gallo. The Tex-Mex Friday dinner, made in twenty minutes of attention.
- [Air-Fryer Steak with Smoked Paprika Aioli](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-steak): Two thick ribeyes, salted heavy, air-fried at 400°F for eight to ten minutes for medium-rare. Sliced on a board, served with a bowl of smoked-paprika aioli for dipping. The steakhouse meal in an appliance you keep on the counter.
- [Air-Fryer Strawberry Doughnuts with Whipped Cottage Cheese](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-strawberry-doughnuts): Filled doughnuts the size of tennis balls: soft yeasted dough, air-fried to gold, dusted in caster sugar, then injected with whipped cottage cheese and a swirl of fresh strawberry compote. The European-bakery filled doughnut, with a clever protein twist in the cream.
- [Air-Fryer Stuffed Chicken Breast](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-stuffed-chicken-breast): Boneless chicken breasts butterflied, packed with a filling of spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, and cream cheese, then air-fried at 380°F until the outside browns and the inside hits 165°F. The fanciest-looking weeknight dinner you'll make all month.
- [Air-Fryer Stuffed Zucchini Boats](https://airfried300.com/recipes/stuffed-zucchini-boats): Zucchini halved, hollowed slightly, filled with seasoned ground beef and onion, topped with crumbled feta and fresh basil, air-fried until the zucchini softens and the filling sets. Mediterranean-leaning, low-carb, the dinner that's both vegetable-and-protein on one plate.
- [Air-Fryer Sweet Potato Fries](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-sweet-potato-fries): Sweet potatoes cut thin, tossed in cornstarch (the trick) and smoked paprika, air-fried at 400°F until the outsides go properly crisp — not the limp, soft sweet-potato fries you get at most restaurants. Served with ketchup, because ketchup is the right answer.
- [Air-Fryer Tostones (Twice-Cooked Plantains)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-plantains): Green plantains sliced thick, fried briefly to soften, smashed flat, then fried again until the edges crackle and the centres stay chewy-tender. Salted heavily, served with garlicky avocado dip. The Puerto Rican / Cuban / Dominican side dish, made in the air fryer with about half the oil.
- [Air-Fryer Tuna Burgers](https://airfried300.com/recipes/tuna-burgers): Canned tuna mixed with green onion, dijon, panko, an egg, formed into proper burger-sized patties, air-fried until the outsides bronze and the insides set. Stacked on soft brioche buns with lettuce and tomato. The pantry burger that's better than the salmon-patty cousin published earlier in this collection.
- [Air-Fryer Tuna Melt](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-tuna-melt): Whole-wheat bread, tuna salad with chopped pickle and dijon, two slices of melting cheddar, four minutes at 380°F. The diner classic, made at home, browner on top because the air fryer hits both sides at once.
- [Air-Fryer Turkey Croquettes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-turkey-croquettes): The Thanksgiving-leftovers dish that justifies cooking a whole turkey by itself. Shredded turkey, mashed potato, scallions, sage, bound into discs, panko-coated, air-fried until the outsides shatter. Served with sour-cream-and-chive dip.
- [Air-Fryer Twice-Baked Potatoes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-twice-baked-potatoes): Russet potatoes baked, scooped, mashed with sour cream, butter, cheddar, and crispy bacon, restuffed into their skins, returned to the air fryer to brown on top. The steakhouse side, on a Tuesday, with chives.
- [Air-Fryer Veggie Sausage Casserole](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-veggie-sausage-casserole): Vegetarian sausages air-fried alongside red onion and pepper, then stirred into a smoky tomato sauce with cannellini beans. The kind of bean-and-sausage stew that's been on British dinner tables for decades, made faster and lighter — the air-frying step browns the sausages properly.
- [Air-Fryer Whole Roast Chicken](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-roast-chicken): A 3-lb chicken, salted overnight, rubbed with herbs and olive oil, air-fried at 360°F for fifty minutes. Comes out with skin like a parchment shell — the colour of dark amber, brittle when you cut through. The Sunday roast, faster, in a smaller appliance.
- [Caramelized Air-Fryer Acorn Squash](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-acorn-squash): Skin-on wedges, golden and caramelized at the edges, sweet enough to forget you didn't add a thing besides olive oil and a pinch of cinnamon. The dry heat of the air fryer concentrates the squash's natural sugars in a way the oven never quite manages.
- [Chili-Lime Chicken Fajitas (Air-Fryer)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/chili-lime-chicken-fajitas): Chicken thigh strips marinated in chili powder, lime, garlic, and cumin, air-fried with peppers and onions in the same basket. Warm tortillas, salsa, sour cream, the whole production. Twenty minutes of marinating, ten minutes of cooking, dinner.
- [Crispy Air-Fryer Breakfast Burritos](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-breakfast-burritos): Eggs, sausage, crispy potatoes, melted cheddar, rolled tight in a flour tortilla, then air-fried for five minutes so the outside crackles. Make six on Sunday, freeze five, eat one immediately.
- [Crispy Air-Fryer Potato Wedges](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-potato-wedges): Crisp on every edge, fluffy inside, skin-on for grip. The trick is a quick cold-water soak before cooking — pulls the surface starch and gives you the shattering crust without a drop of deep-fryer oil.
- [Crispy Air-Fryer Roast Potatoes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-roast-potatoes): British "roasties" — par-boiled potatoes, roughed up against the colander, dropped into hot oil, air-fried until the outsides go glass-crisp and the insides stay fluffy. The Sunday-dinner cornerstone, made in less than an hour without using the oven.
- [Easy Air-Fryer Hot Dogs](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-hotdogs): Five minutes, no boiling water, no spluttering pan. The hot dogs crisp and split along their length the way a good grilled dog does, and the buns toast on top of them for the last minute. Ketchup, mustard, relish, done.
- [Homemade Air-Fryer Churros](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-churros): Choux-style dough piped through a star tip into the air fryer basket, cooked until ridges go bronze, then rolled in cinnamon sugar. Served with dark chocolate dipping sauce. The Spanish fairground pastry, made at home without a deep fryer.
- [Maple-Bacon Squash & Pecan Salad](https://airfried300.com/recipes/maple-bacon-squash-pecan-salad): Butternut squash glazed with maple syrup, smoky bacon crisped in the basket, candied pecans, baby spinach, and a yogurt-tahini drizzle. The autumn salad that's actually filling — sweet, salty, smoky, with three different textures of crunch.
- [Naked Air-Fryer Chicken Tenders](https://airfried300.com/recipes/air-fryer-chicken-tenders-no-breading): Chicken tenders for when you don't want the bread. Olive oil, dried herbs, garlic, salt — and ten minutes at 400°F. Crisp at the edges, juicy through the middle, no flour anywhere near.
- [Shawarma-Spiced Squash & Veggie Sausage Bake](https://airfried300.com/recipes/shawarma-squash-veggie-sausage-bake): Butternut squash and vegetarian sausages roasted with shawarma spice — cumin, coriander, paprika, garlic — served on warm flatbread with cool yogurt-cucumber sauce and crunchy butterhead lettuce. The traybake adapted for the air-fryer basket, and the Middle-Eastern flavour palette adapted for a weeknight.
- [Spicy Bean Jacket Potatoes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/spicy-bean-jacket-potatoes): Big baking potatoes air-fried until the skins crackle, split open and topped with spiced-up baked beans (a can of beans, smoked paprika, chipotle, a glug of barbecue sauce), grated cheddar, and pickled jalapeños. The pub-lunch classic, made spicy enough to be interesting.
- [Sticky Pork & Rice-Noodle Lettuce Wraps](https://airfried300.com/recipes/sticky-pork-noodle-lettuce-wraps): Air-fried pork belly chunks glazed in a sticky soy-ginger-honey sauce, served in baby gem lettuce cups with rice noodles, julienned carrot, and fresh coriander. A summer dish that doesn't ask you to turn on the oven, with the kind of finger-food assembly that turns dinner into a project everyone's happy to participate in.
- [The Best Air-Fryer Chips (Triple-Cooked Method)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/the-best-air-fryer-chips): The Heston Blumenthal triple-cooked chip technique, adapted for the air fryer. Parboil, dry-chill, blanch at low temperature, chill again, finish at high temperature. The result: a shell so crisp it shatters audibly under your teeth, an interior so soft it pulls apart like proper mashed potato.
- [Twice-Baked Potatoes with Kale, Ham & Goat's Cheese](https://airfried300.com/recipes/twice-baked-potatoes-kale-ham-goat-cheese): Big baked potatoes scooped, mashed with sautéed kale, smoked ham, and tangy goat's cheese, restuffed into their skins, returned to the air fryer to brown on top. The pub lunch made fancier, the twice-baked elevated above the steakhouse standard.
- [Za'atar Salmon Traybake with Potato Wedges & Cherry Tomatoes](https://airfried300.com/recipes/zaatar-salmon-traybake): Salmon fillets rubbed with za'atar, potato wedges roasted alongside, vine cherry tomatoes blistered until they burst. Finished with a herb-and-yogurt drizzle that cuts through the spice. Twenty-five minutes from cold to plate, the Mediterranean dinner that proves traybakes aren't just for sheet pans.

## No-cook recipes
- [Buffalo Chicken Salad Meal Prep](https://airfried300.com/recipes/buffalo-chicken-salad-meal-prep): Shredded chicken tossed with buffalo sauce, ranch (or blue cheese), and chopped celery, packed into containers with blueberries and pistachios for four lunches that pretend to be one big snack plate. Done in fifteen minutes; lunch is handled until Friday.
- [Caesar Chicken Salad Wraps](https://airfried300.com/recipes/caesar-chicken-salad-wraps): Shredded rotisserie chicken folded into a creamy lemon-anchovy Caesar dressing, lots of crisp romaine, parmesan, in a soft flour tortilla. Lunch for the rest of the week, with a fridge that already has its ingredients.
- [Tuna & Egg Salad Meal Prep](https://airfried300.com/recipes/tuna-egg-salad-meal-prep): Tuna salad and egg salad in one — the protein-dense version of both, bound by mayo and Dijon, with chopped pickles, fresh dill, celery for crunch. Three lunches portioned with strawberries and crackers, ready to grab on the way out.

## No-bake recipes
- [No-Bake Cheesecake Yogurt Cups](https://airfried300.com/recipes/no-bake-cheesecake-yogurt-cups): Graham cracker crumb base, sweetened Greek yogurt and cream cheese layer (the cheesecake-without-baking move), mixed berries on top. Twelve minutes to assemble, four mason jars to keep in the fridge for the next four days you need something sweet that's also breakfast.
- [No-Bake Pecan Pie Date Balls](https://airfried300.com/recipes/no-bake-pecan-pie-date-balls): Pecans, Medjool dates, a splash of maple, vanilla, salt — pulsed in a food processor until they hold together, rolled into balls, dusted with more chopped pecans. Tastes like pecan pie. Has zero ingredients that wouldn't be in a salad dressing.
- [Pistachio-Date Energy Balls](https://airfried300.com/recipes/pistachio-date-energy-balls): Pistachios, Medjool dates, cardamom, rose water (optional), rolled in more ground pistachios for the green coat. The Middle-Eastern cousin of the pecan-pie ball — same technique, completely different flavour language. Cardamom is the secret.

## Stovetop recipes
- [Lemon-Herb Chicken Pasta Salad](https://airfried300.com/recipes/lemon-herb-chicken-pasta-salad): Bowtie pasta, diced chicken, parmesan, parsley, dill, a heavy-handed dressing of olive oil and lemon. Made warm, eaten cold (or room-temp), the kind of pasta salad that doesn't apologise for being a pasta salad.
- [Lemony Chicken & Corn Orzo Salad](https://airfried300.com/recipes/lemony-chicken-corn-orzo-salad): Orzo cooked al dente, tossed warm with charred corn, grilled chicken, feta, fresh basil, a lemon-olive-oil dressing. The pasta salad that's somehow lighter than pasta salad has any right to be. August dinner on a plate.
- [Moroccan Parsnip & Green Olive Stew](https://airfried300.com/recipes/moroccan-parsnip-olive-stew): Parsnips, butternut squash, and chickpeas slow-cooked with green olives, preserved lemon, ras-el-hanout, and saffron — finished with fresh mint and served over fluffy couscous. The kind of winter stew that turns a few root vegetables into something fragrant and substantial.
- [Stovetop Chicken Breast for Meal Prep](https://airfried300.com/recipes/stovetop-chicken-breast-meal-prep): The plain-cooked chicken breast that becomes everything: chicken salad, sliced over greens, diced into bowls, on a sandwich. Smoky paprika rub, a hot pan, no oven required. Six minutes per side and four lunches are handled.

## Skillet & one-pan recipes
- [Chipotle Chicken Burritos with Lime Crema](https://airfried300.com/recipes/chipotle-chicken-burritos): Shredded chicken in a chipotle-and-honey glaze, rolled with red cabbage slaw, refried black beans, and avocado — all tucked into big flour tortillas and pan-toasted until the outsides crack like a quesadilla. Served with cool lime crema for dipping.
- [Egg-Fried Vegetable Rice](https://airfried300.com/recipes/egg-fried-vegetable-rice): Day-old jasmine rice, scrambled egg, soy, sesame oil, sliced carrots, red cabbage, mangetout, finished with spring onion and a fresh chilli. The takeaway side dish made the main event, in fifteen minutes flat, in one pan.
- [Sloppy Joe Tater-Tot Casserole](https://airfried300.com/recipes/sloppy-joe-tater-tot-casserole): Ground turkey or beef cooked in a smoky-sweet sauce, blanketed with frozen tater tots, baked in a cast-iron skillet until the tots crisp and the cheese melts. Childhood comfort food with grown-up seasoning. One pan, six servings, leftovers welcome.
- [Soyrizo Breakfast Burritos (Meal Prep)](https://airfried300.com/recipes/soyrizo-breakfast-burritos): Soyrizo, scrambled eggs, crispy roasted potatoes, melted cheese, all rolled in a soft tortilla and pan-toasted to crisp the outside. The vegetarian breakfast burrito that satisfies meat-eaters by accident. Make six, freeze five.
- [Unstuffed Pepper Bowls](https://airfried300.com/recipes/unstuffed-pepper-bowls): Everything that's good about stuffed peppers — ground beef, peppers, onion, marinara, melty cheese, rice — without the half-hour of bell- pepper-hollowing-and-stuffing logistics. One skillet, four containers, Sunday-afternoon kind of cooking.

## Blender drinks
- [Blueberry Peanut Butter Cinnamon Smoothie](https://airfried300.com/recipes/blueberry-pb-cinnamon-smoothie): Frozen blueberries, banana, peanut butter powder, cinnamon, milk — blended to deep purple, topped with a few fresh blueberries and a dust of cinnamon. The kind of smoothie that tastes like blueberry muffin batter, which is exactly the point.

## Metadata conventions
- `category`: Mains, Sides, Breakfast, Snacks, Dessert, Sandwich, Pantry, Meal Prep
- `method`: air-fryer | no-cook | no-bake | stovetop | skillet | blender
- `active_minutes` / `total_minutes`: realistic timings, tested
- `servings`: number of portions at the stated quantities
- `difficulty`: Easy | Medium | Hard
- `tags`: free-form list (e.g. weeknight, kids, gluten-free, freezer-friendly)
